title: Backlog workspace-leftovers-followups: case-exact allowlist lookup in the gate, suite selection through sys.path imports, Windows TMPDIR in the workspace default suite

tasks.grade_reason: one argument in one call plus one test case
tasks.objective: Backlog topic workspace-leftovers-followups item 1. scripts/factory-pipeline.py run_lead_file_blockers passes norm_path(path) to first_english_breach (near line 3244); norm_path is case-folded on Windows, so an english-only allowlist entry for a run lead file whose path has upper-case letters does not match there and the gate reports a false English blocker that CI (scripts/checks/english-only.py) would not. Look the allowlist up with the exact tree path as scripts/checks/english-only.py does; keep norm_path for the run lead file membership test. Test in tests/pipeline.test.sh: an allowlisted run lead file with a mixed-case path passes the gate. Changelog fragment changelog.d/leftovers-gate-allowlist-case.md (### Fixed).
acceptance: an allowlist entry for a mixed-case run lead file path matches on every platform
the gate and scripts/checks/english-only.py agree on allowlisted lines

tasks.grade_reason: suite selection logic; a selection that is too narrow lets a regression through CI
tasks.objective: Backlog topic workspace-leftovers-followups item 3. tests/affected.py treats any module whose source mentions sys.path, importlib or __import__ as unsure (near line 298), so a change to scripts/lib/workspace.py (imported by scripts/lib/fstate.py and the guard modules after a sys.path insert of scripts/lib or scripts) selects every suite. Teach the import graph the plugin's own idiom: a sys.path.insert/append whose argument is built only from os.path.dirname(__file__)/os.path.join with string literals (resolve it statically to a directory of this repo) adds that directory to the module's import roots, and the module is then no longer unsure for that reason; anything else (computed paths, importlib, __import__) stays unsure. Measure the suite count for a change to scripts/lib/workspace.py and scripts/lib/fstate.py before and after with `python3 -B tests/affected.py select-many` and report both. Keep hashes (suite reuse) conservative. Update the docstring rule list. Tests in tests/affected.test.sh: the idiom resolves and a change to workspace.py selects its real importers' suites (workspace-default, routing, session-state, file-guard) and not an unrelated suite; a computed sys.path entry stays unsure. Changelog fragment changelog.d/leftovers-affected-syspath.md (### Changed).
acceptance: a change to scripts/lib/workspace.py no longer selects every suite
every suite that imports it, directly or through the guard and state modules, is still selected
a computed sys.path entry or importlib use stays unsure
